4901.synonym: ajjhapatta, ajjhupagata, ajjhupāgata, ajjhūpagata, āgata, sampatta

examples.text: assosuṃ kho thūṇeyyakā brāhmaṇagahapatikā, samaṇo khalu, bho, gotamo sakyaputto sakyakulā pabbajito mallesu cārikaṃ caramāno mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ thūṇaṃ anuppatto'ti.

assosuṃ kho vesālikā licchavī, bhagavā kira koṭigāmaṃ anuppatto'ti. atha kho vesālikā licchavī bhadrāni bhadrāni yānāni yojāpetvā bhadraṃ bhadraṃ yānaṃ abhiruhitvā bhadrehi bhadrehi yānehi vesāliyā niyyāsuṃ bhagavantaṃ dassanāya.
yo so, bhante, bhikkhu arahaṃ khīṇ'āsavo vusitavā katakaraṇīyo ohitabhāro anuppattasadattho parikkhīṇabhavasaṃyojano samma'd'aññāvimutto, so cha ṭhānāni adhimutto hoti
anuppatto no sāmaññ'attho n'atthi no kiñci uttariṃ karaṇīyan'ti
ayam'pi ubhato koṭiko pañho tava-anuppatto, so tayā nibbāhitabbo'ti.

4904.meaning1: who has achieved the highest goal; who has attained one's purpose; epithet of an arahant

examples.text: yo so, bhante, bhikkhu arahaṃ khīṇ'āsavo vusitavā katakaraṇīyo ohitabhāro anuppattasadattho parikkhīṇabhavasaṃyojano samma'd'aññāvimutto, so cha ṭhānāni adhimutto hoti
khīṇ'āsavassa, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno vusitavato katakaraṇīyassa ohitabhārassa anuppattasadatthassa parikkhīṇabhavasaṃyojanassa samma'd'aññāvimuttassa ayam'anudhammo hoti veyyākaraṇāya
ettāvatā kho, bhāradvāja, sacc'ānubodho hoti, ettāvatā saccam'anubujjhati, ettāvatā ca mayaṃ sacc'ānubodhaṃ paññapema, na tv'eva tāva sacca-anuppatti hotī'ti.
ye ca te, tāta, vijite adhanā assu, tesañ'ca dhanam'anuppadajjeyyāsi.

4908.meaning1: will give; will offer; will pay
4908.commentary: (DNa) dakkhiṇaṃ anuppadassāmī'ti tesaṃ pattidānaṃ katvā tatiyadivasato paṭṭhāya dānaṃ anuppadassāmi.

examples.text: na hi, deva, jīvāmī'ti. atha kho, bhikkhave, rañño khattiyassa muddh'ābhisittassa etadahosi, sace kho ahaṃ yo yo paresaṃ adinnaṃ theyyasaṅkhātaṃ ādiyissati, tassa tassa dhanam'anuppadassāmi, evam'idaṃ adinn'ādānaṃ pavaḍḍhissati.

4909.meaning1: (of money) should be handed over; should be paid for; should be coughed up

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, ānanda, puriso daliddo assako anāḷhiko, tassa akāmakassa bilaṃ olaggeyyuṃ, idaṃ te, ambho purisa, maṃsañ'ca khāditabbaṃ, mūlañ'ca anuppadātabban'ti.

4910.commentary: (ANa) anuppadātā'ti sandhān'ānuppadātā, dve jane samagge disvā tumhākaṃ evarūpe kule jātānaṃ evarūpehi guṇehi samannāgatānaṃ anucchavikam'etan'tiādīni vatvā daḷhīkammaṃ kattā'ti attho.

examples.text: iti bhinnānaṃ vā sandhātā sahitānaṃ vā anuppadātā samagg'ārāmo samaggarato samagganandī samaggakaraṇiṃ vācaṃ bhāsitā hoti

pisuṇavāco kho pana hoti. ito sutvā amutra akkhātā imesaṃ bhedāya, amutra vā sutvā imesaṃ akkhātā amūsaṃ bhedāya. iti samaggānaṃ vā bhettā, bhinnānaṃ vā anuppadātā, vagg'ārāmo vaggarato vagganandī vaggakaraṇiṃ vācaṃ bhāsitā hoti.

4912.meaning1: to pay back (something to); to pay the interest (on)
4912.commentary: (ANa) amhākañ'ca kālena kālaṃ anuppadātun'ti amhākañ'ca gahitadhanamūlikaṃ vaḍḍhiṃ kālena kālaṃ anuppadātuṃ.

examples.text: kathañ'ca, bhikkhave, pāpaṇiko nissayasampanno hoti? idha bhikkhave, pāpaṇikaṃ ye te gahapatī vā gahapatiputtā vā aḍḍhā mahaddhanā mahābhogā te evaṃ jānanti, ayaṃ kho bhavaṃ pāpaṇiko cakkhumā vidhuro ca paṭibalo puttadārañ'ca posetuṃ, amhākañ'ca kālena kālaṃ anuppadātun'ti.

4914.commentary: (ANa) anuppadānenā'ti satassa vā sahassassa vā dānena. (ANa) anuppadānarato'ti punappunaṃ dānaṃ dadamāno'va ramati.

examples.text: jappena mantena subhāsitena, anuppadānena paveṇiyā vā, yathā yathā yattha labhetha atthaṃ, tathā tathā tattha parakkameyya.
taṃ kiṃ maññasi, sīha, idha dve purisā, eko puriso assaddho maccharī kadariyo paribhāsako, eko puriso saddho dānapati anuppadānarato.

te evarūpāya tiracchānavijjāya micchājīvena jīvitaṃ kappenti, seyyath'idaṃ… vamanaṃ virecanaṃ uddhaṃvirecanaṃ adhovirecanaṃ sīsavirecanaṃ kaṇṇatelaṃ nettatappanaṃ natthukammaṃ añjanaṃ paccañjanaṃ sālākiyaṃ sallakattiyaṃ dārakatikicchā mūlabhesajjānaṃ anuppadānaṃ osadhīnaṃ paṭimokkho
evaṃ, bho'ti kho, brāhmaṇa, rājā mahāvijito purohitassa brāhmaṇassa paṭissutvā ye rañño janapade ussahiṃsu kasigorakkhe, tesaṃ rājā mahāvijito bījabhattaṃ anuppadāsi.

4917.commentary: (KHPa) balañ'ca bhikkhūnam'anuppadinnan'ti iminā samuttejeti. bal'ānuppadānam'eva hi ettha evaṃ dānaṃ, bal'ānuppadānatā'ti tassa ussāhavaḍḍhanena samuttejanaṃ.

examples.text: so ñātidhammo ca ayaṃ nidassito, petāna'pūjā ca katā uḷārā, balañ'ca bhikkhūnam'anuppadinnaṃ, tumhehi puññaṃ pasutaṃ anappakan'ti.

4918.grammar: prp of pass of anu pa √dā, pass, trans (+acc)

examples.text: adhanānaṃ dhane ananuppadiyamāne dāliddiyaṃ vepullam'agamāsi. dāliddiye vepullaṃ gate aññataro puriso paresaṃ adinnaṃ theyyasaṅkhātaṃ ādiyi. tam'enaṃ aggahesuṃ.

4919.meaning2: is being given; is being offered

examples.text: te naṃ bhogehi nipatanti, ito, samma pāpaṇika, bhoge karitvā puttadārañ'ca posehi, amhākañ'ca kālena kālaṃ anuppadehī'ti. evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, pāpaṇiko nissayasampanno hoti.

4921.commentary: (DNa) anuppadetū'ti dinne appahonte puna aññam'pi bījañ'ca bhattañ'ca kasiupakaraṇabhaṇḍañ'ca sabbaṃ detū'ti attho. pābhataṃ anuppadetū'ti sakkhiṃ akatvā paṇṇe anāropetvā mūlacchejjavasena bhaṇḍamūlaṃ detū'ti attho. bhaṇḍamūlassa hi pābhatan'ti nāmaṃ.

examples.text: tena hi bhavaṃ rājā ye bhoto rañño janapade ussahanti kasigorakkhe, tesaṃ bhavaṃ rājā bījabhattaṃ anuppadetu. ye bhoto rañño janapade ussahanti vāṇijjāya, tesaṃ bhavaṃ rājā pābhataṃ anuppadetu.
tassa evaṃ kicc'āpadesabahulassa viharato anuppannā c'eva bhogā n'uppajjanti, uppannā ca bhogā parikkhayaṃ gacchanti.
niccaṃ utrastam'idaṃ cittaṃ, niccaṃ ubbiggam'idaṃ mano, anuppannesu kicchesu, atho uppatitesu ca, sace atthi anutrastaṃ, taṃ me akkhāhi pucchito'ti.

4923.meaning2: rule concerning a case not yet occurred

4924.meaning2: fact of not having occurred before

examples.text: so catassannaṃ parisānaṃ dhammaṃ deseti parimaṇḍalehi padabyañjanehi anuppabandhehi anusayasamugghātāya. evarūpena kho, āvuso sāriputta, bhikkhunā gosiṅgasālavanaṃ sobheyyā'ti.

4928.meaning2: anchoring, keeping tied down (description of vicāra)

4931.meaning2: fact of additional usage; fact of using a similar word having the same meaning as the previous one

4933.meaning2: entered, gone into; resorted to; present (in)

4934.meaning2: enters (after); goes into; resorts to; is present (in)

4935.commentary: (DNa) anuppaveccheyyā'ti anupaveseyya, na sammā vasseyya, anvaddhamāsaṃ anudas'āhaṃ anupañc'āhaṃ na vasseyyā'ti attho.

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, udakarahado ubbhid'odako. tassa n'ev'assa puratthimāya disāya udakassa āyamukhaṃ… devo ca na kālena kālaṃ sammādhāraṃ anuppaveccheyya.

4936.meaning1: non-arising; non-appearance; not coming into existence

examples.text: yathā ca anuppannassa kāmacchandassa uppādo hoti tañ'ca pajānāti, yathā ca uppannassa kāmacchandassa pahānaṃ hoti tañ'ca pajānāti, yathā ca pahīnassa kāmacchandassa āyatiṃ anuppādo hoti tañ'ca pajānāti
tathāgatassa, pāpima, ye āsavā saṃkilesikā ponobbhavikā sadarā dukkhavipākā āyatiṃ jātijarāmaraṇiyā, te pahīnā ucchinnamūlā tāl'āvatthukatā anabhāvaṃkatā āyatiṃ anuppādadhammā.
evarūpassa, bhikkhave, puggalassa lobhajā pāpakā akusalā dhammā pahīnā ucchinnamūlā tāl'āvatthukatā anabhāvaṃkatā āyatiṃ anuppādadhammā.
evam'eva kho, sunakkhatta, sammā nibbān'ādhimuttassa purisapuggalassa ye n'evasaññā-n'āsaññ'āyatana-saṃyojane se ucchinnamūle tāl'āvatthukate anabhāvaṃkate āyatiṃ anuppādadhamme.

examples.text: manāpe rūpe rāgaṃ, amanāpe dosaṃ, asamapekkhite mohan'ti evaṃ rāg'ādikilese anuppādento upekkhakabhāvena sahati.

4943.meaning1: what is pleasing; what is flattering; what one loves
4943.meaning2: what is pleasing; what is flattering; what one loves

examples.text: pāpakaṃ'pi'ssa anujānāti, kalyāṇaṃ'p'issa anujānāti, sammukhāssa vaṇṇaṃ bhāsati, parammukhāssa avaṇṇaṃ bhāsati. imehi kho, gahapatiputta, catūhi ṭhānehi anuppiyabhāṇī amitto mittapatirūpako veditabbo.

4944.commentary: (DNa) anupiyan'ti evaṃnāmako mallānaṃ janapadassa eko nigamo, taṃ gocaragāmaṃ katvā ekasmiṃ chāy'ūdakasampanne vanasaṇḍe viharatī'ti attho. anopiyan'ti'pi pāṭho.

examples.text: evaṃ me sutaṃ, ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā mallesu viharati anuppiyaṃ nāma mallānaṃ nigamo. atha kho bhagavā pubb'aṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaram'ādāya anuppiyaṃ piṇḍāya pāvisi.

4945.meaning1: flattering; saying only what one wants to hear

examples.text: pāpakaṃ'pi'ssa anujānāti, kalyāṇaṃ'p'issa anujānāti, sammukhāssa vaṇṇaṃ bhāsati, parammukhāssa avaṇṇaṃ bhāsati. imehi kho, gahapatiputta, catūhi ṭhānehi anuppiyabhāṇī amitto mittapatirūpako veditabbo.

4946.meaning2: free from oppression; free from distress

4948.meaning1: not oppressed; not harassed; not troubled
4948.commentary: (JAa anuppīḷan'ti kacci raṭṭhavāsino yante ucchuṃ viya na pīḷesī'ti pucchati.

examples.text: atha kho, brāhmaṇa, rājā mahāvijito purohitaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ āmantetvā etadavoca, samūhato kho me bhoto dassukhīlo, bhoto saṃvidhānaṃ āgamma mahā ca me rāsiko. khemaṭṭhitā janapadā akaṇṭakā anuppīḷā manussā mudā modamānā ure putte naccentā apārutagharā maññe viharanti.
it'iha te ubho ācariy'antevāsī aññam'aññassa ujuvipaccanīkavādā bhagavantaṃ piṭṭhito piṭṭhito anubaddhā honti bhikkhusaṅghañ'ca.
akkhato kho'mhi, tāta kumma, anupahato, atthi ca me idaṃ suttakaṃ piṭṭhito piṭṭhito anubandhan'ti.
ime kho, ambho purisa, pañca vadhakā paccatthikā piṭṭhito piṭṭhito anubandhā, yatth'eva naṃ passissāma tatth'eva jīvitā voropessāmā'ti. yaṃ te, ambho purisa, karaṇīyaṃ taṃ karohī'ti.
ākhyāta-sāgaram'ath'ajjatanī-taraṅ'gaṃ, dhātujjalaṃ vikaraṇ'āgamakālamīnaṃ, lopa-anubandh'ariyam'atthavibhāgatīraṃ, dhīrā taranti kavino puthubuddhināvā.
atha kho uttarassa māṇavassa etadahosi, samannāgato kho samaṇo gotamo dvattiṃsa-mahāpurisalakkhaṇehi. yaṃnūn'āhaṃ samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ anubandheyyaṃ, iriyāpatham'assa passeyyan'ti.
puriso ca te ukkhitt'āsiko piṭṭhito piṭṭhito anubandhissati. yatth'eva naṃ thokam'pi chaḍḍessati tatth'eva te siro pātessatī'ti.

4959.meaning2: following; keeping close to, attending closely; pursuing

examples.text: kiṃ ummatto'si, nanu idān'eva divākaro atthaṅ'gato, so kathaṃ imaṃ puṇṇacandaṃ anubandhamāno uggacchissati?
atha kho āyasmā sāriputto taramānarūpo nisīdanaṃ ādāya āyasmantaṃ puṇṇaṃ mantāṇiputtaṃ piṭṭhito piṭṭhito anubandhi sīs'ānulokī.
satta vassāni bhagavantaṃ, anubandhiṃ padāpadaṃ, otāraṃ n'ādhigacchissaṃ, sambuddhassa satīmato.

4963.meaning1: should be followed; should be trailed (by)
4963.commentary: (ANa) anubandhitabban'ti iriyāpath'ānugamanena anubandhitabbaṃ maṃ na vijahitabbaṃ maññanti.

examples.text: eko'va bhagavā tasmiṃ samaye viharitu'kāmo hoti na bhagavā tasmiṃ samaye kenaci anubandhitabbo hotī'ti
evam'evaṃ pan'idh'ekacce moghapurisā mamaññ'eva ajjhesanti. dhamme ca bhāsite mamaññ'eva anubandhitabbaṃ maññantī'ti.

4964.meaning1: to follow; to attend closely to

examples.text: ime kho te, ānanda, dhammā ek'antakusalā kusal'āyatikā ariyā lok'uttarā anavakkantā pāpimatā. taṃ kiṃ maññasi, ānanda, kaṃ atthavasaṃ sampassamāno arahati sāvako satthāraṃ anubandhituṃ api paṇujjamāno'ti, bhagavaṃmūlakā no, bhante, dhammā bhagavaṃnettikā bhagavaṃpaṭisaraṇā.
bhante pubbe dīpino eḷake khādanti ahaṃ pana eḷake dīpino anubandhitvā murumurū'ti khādante addasaṃ

4969.commentary: (JAa) na anubujjhatī'ti yathāsabhāvena na jānāti, pacchā ca anutappati.

examples.text: ettāvatā, bho gotama, sacc'ānurakkhaṇā hoti, ettāvatā saccam'anurakkhati, ettāvatā ca mayaṃ sacc'ānurakkhaṇaṃ pekkhāma. kittāvatā pana, bho gotama, sacc'ānubodho hoti, kittāvatā saccam'anubujjhati? sacc'ānubodhaṃ mayaṃ bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ pucchāmā'ti.
yo ca uppatitaṃ atthaṃ, na khippam'anubujjhati, amittavasam'anveti, pacchā ca anutappati.

4970.commentary: (JAa) na anubujjhatī'ti yathāsabhāvena na jānāti, pacchā ca anutappati.

examples.text: acchariyaṃ, āvuso, abbhutaṃ, āvuso! yāvañ'c'idaṃ tena bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena sambādhe okās'ādhigamo anubuddho sattānaṃ visuddhiyā sokaparidevānaṃ samatikkamāya dukkhadomanassānaṃ atthaṅ'gamāya ñāyassa adhigamāya nibbānassa sacchikiriyāya.
sace kho tvaṃ, mārisa, evaṃ pajānāsi, sace tvaṃ evaṃ anubuddho, mā sāvake upanesi, mā pabbajite, mā sāvakānaṃ dhammaṃ desesi, mā pabbajitānaṃ, mā sāvakesu gedhim'akāsi, mā pabbajitesu.

4975.meaning1: following the Buddha; immediately after Buddha
4975.commentary: (SNa) buddh'ānubuddho'ti paṭhamaṃ satthā cattāri saccāni bujjhi, pacchā thero, tasmā buddh'ānubuddho'ti vuccati.

4977.meaning2: conviction, certainty, discovery owed to another

examples.text: ettāvatā kho bhāradvāja sacc'ānurakkhaṇā hoti, ettāvatā saccam'anurakkhati, ettāvatā ca mayaṃ sacc'ānurakkhaṇaṃ paññāpema, na tv'eva tāva sacca-anubodho hoti.

4979.meaning2: conviction, certainty, discovery owed to another

4982.commentary: (NIDD1a) anubyañjanaggāhī'ti kilesānaṃ anuanubyañjanato pākaṭabhāvakaraṇato anubyañjanan'ti laddhavohāraṃ hattha-pāda-sita-hasita-kathita-ālokita-vilokit'ādi-bhedaṃ ākāraṃ gaṇhāti.

examples.text: idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā nimittaggāhī hoti anubyañjanaggāhī. yatv'ādhikaraṇam'enaṃ cakkhu'ndriyaṃ asaṃvutaṃ viharantaṃ abhijjhādomanassā pāpakā akusalā dhammā anvāssaveyyuṃ, tassa saṃvarāya na paṭipajjati, na rakkhati cakkhu'ndriyaṃ, cakkhu'ndriye na saṃvaraṃ āpajjati.

4983.meaning1: (vinaya) detailed exposition of a rule; commentary
4983.commentary: (VINa) suttato anubyañjanato'ti pāḷito ca paripucchato ca aṭṭhakathāto ca suvinicchitaṃ hoti, kaṅkhacchedaṃ katvā uggahitaṃ.

examples.text: katamāni tīṇi? suttañ'c'assa svāgataṃ hoti suppavatti suvinicchitaṃ suttato anubyañjanato'ti idam'ekaṃ lakkhaṇaṃ. vinaye kho pana ṭhito hoti asaṃhīro'ti idaṃ dutiyaṃ.

4984.meaning1: enticed by the details; focussing on the secondary characteristics
4984.commentary: (NIDD2a) anubyañjanaggāhī'ti kilesānaṃ anubyañjanato pākaṭabhāvakaraṇato anubyañjanan'ti laddhavohāraṃ hatthapāda-hasita-lapita-vilokit'ādi-bhedaṃ ākāraṃ gaṇhāti.

examples.text: idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā nimittaggāhī hoti anubyañjanaggāhī.

4986.commentary: (SNa) anubyañjanaso nimittaggāho'ti hatthā sobhanā pādā sobhanā'ti evaṃ anubyañjanavasena nimittaggāho. nimittaggāho'ti hi saṃsandetvā gahaṇaṃ, anubyañjanaggāho'ti vibhattigahaṇaṃ. nimittaggāho kumbhīlasadiso sabbam'eva gaṇhāti, anubyañjanaggāho rattapāsadiso vibhajitvā hatthapād'ādīsu taṃ taṃ koṭṭhāsaṃ. ime pana dve gāhā ekajavanavāre'pi labbhanti, nānājavanavāre vattabbam'eva n'atthi.

examples.text: varaṃ, bhikkhave, tattāya ayosalākāya ādittāya sampajjalitāya sajotibhūtāya cakkhu'ndriyaṃ sampalimaṭṭhaṃ, na tv'eva cakkhuviññeyyesu rūpesu anubyañjanaso nimittaggāho.

4987.meaning1: bound to enjoyment of the features; attached to the pleasure in the details; tied to the gratification in the secondary characteristics
4987.meaning2: bound to enjoyment in features; attached to pleasure in details; tied to gratification in secondary characteristics

examples.text: nimitt'assādagathitaṃ vā, bhikkhave, viññāṇaṃ tiṭṭhamānaṃ tiṭṭheyya, anubyañjan'assādagathitaṃ vā tasmiñ'ce samaye kālaṃ kareyya

4988.grammar: ind, adv, acc sg of anubyañjana
4988.meaning1: (of recitation) next phrase; one phrase following the next
4988.construction:
anu + vi + √añj + ana + aṃ

4988.commentary: (VIN 2.5.1.4) anubyañjanaṃ nāma rūpaṃ aniccan'ti vuccamāno, vedanā aniccā'ti saddaṃ nicchāreti. (VINa) anubyañjanan'ti purimabyañjanena sadisaṃ pacchābyañjanaṃ.

examples.text: padaso nāma padaṃ, anupadaṃ, anvakkharaṃ, anubyañjanaṃ.

4989.meaning2: makes increase, fosters; devotes oneself to; practices

examples.text: araññe rukkhamūlesu, kandarāsu guhāsu ca, vivekam'anubrūhantā, vihaṃsu tapparāyanā.

4991.synonym: pavaḍḍhati, brūhayati, bhāvayati, bhāveti, vaḍḍhati, vaddhati

examples.text: aññā hi lābh'ūpanisā, aññā nibbānagāminī, evam'etaṃ abhiññāya, bhikkhu buddhassa sāvako, sakkāraṃ n'ābhinandeyya, vivekam'anubrūhaye.
paccuppannañ'ca yo dhammaṃ, tattha tattha vipassati, asaṃhīraṃ asaṃkuppaṃ, taṃ vidvā m'anubrūhaye.
